## Behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and resulting behavior.

## Boundaries

- [ ] Tenant/workspace/account/group scope and epoch checks remain enforced.
- [ ] Readiness is not inferred from saved configuration or service health.
- [ ] No secret, native account data or expired conversation is included.
- [ ] Architecture/migration/capability records updated when relevant.
- [ ] Structural changes include source-backed architecture differences; only
      affected Mermaid views changed and human decisions remain intact.
- [ ] CodeBoarding incremental result or explicit baseline/coverage limitation
      recorded without publishing credentials, transcripts or untrusted caches.

## Validation

List executed checks and any remaining acceptance gap.
